entities.summary: Abdallah ibn Faḍlallah Sharaf al-Din Shīrāzī, called Wassaf or Vassaf, was a Persian historian of the Ilkhanate. Waṣṣāf, sometimes lengthened to Waṣṣāf al-Ḥaḍrat or Vassaf-e Hazrat, is a title meaning "court panegyrist".
